notes: The second isnad («وقال عبد الله بن الوليد حدثنا سفيان عن معاوية بهذا») follows the saying and carries it, so it is a route of the same saying, not a variant. «بهذا» stands for the names after معاوية, so it is the final back-reference link.
The two groups repeat their own names, so there is no shared tail.
